🎓 LATERAL ENTRY (LEET) – 2nd Year Direct Admission:

Eligibility (minimum 60% marks):
✅ ITI 2-year course (after 10th)
✅ 10+2 Vocational in relevant branch
✅ 10+2 Science stream
✅ 2-year certificate from SLIET Longowal

📌 Admission through Punjab State Board counseling
🌐 punjabtechced.com
💰 LEET General: ₹22,370 | SC: ₹4,953

🌾 RURAL QUOTA (70% Seats):

Qualifies if:
✅ Parents permanently reside in rural Punjab
✅ Studied minimum 3 years in a rural school
✅ Passed 5th/8th/10th from rural school

📌 Rural = outside Municipal Corp, Committee, NAC, Cantonment
📌 Fill Form No.11 from Board prospectus

🕌 SIKH MINORITY QUOTA (50% Seats):

✅ 50% seats reserved for Sikh minority students
✅ Must clear SRE (Sikh Religious Examination) by SGPC

🌐 SRE Info: bbsbec.ac.in
📌 Contact SGPC, Amritsar for test schedule

🏆 SCHOLARSHIPS AT GNDPC:

✅ SC/ST: Pay only ₹1,133 if family income < ₹2.5L/year
✅ Government of Punjab reservations apply
✅ Gill Donor Category: Reduced fees

🌐 Scholarship Info
📌 Apply within 30 days of admission
📌 Need: Income certificate, caste certificate, domicile
